verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source, self-hosted Python framework — it is not a SaaS product that phones home usage telemetry to the vendor by default; the story about opting out of telemetry/usage tracking is a category question more suited to hosted developer tools, and no evidence pack content discusses any telemetry collection mechanism at all (self-hosted OSS frameworks typically don't have this axis in the same sense).
